tools.name: empiva_get_stay_quote
tools.description: Get the authoritative price for a specific villa and date range. Provide the villa slug (from empiva_search_villas) and check-in/check-out dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Returns the nightly breakdown and total in EUR and whether the stay meets the villa's minimum-nights rule.

tools.name: empiva_get_villa
tools.description: Get full details for one Empiva villa by slug: description, bedrooms, capacity, amenities, minimum nights and indicative nightly rate (EUR). Use empiva_get_stay_quote for the exact price on dates.

tools.name: empiva_list_dining
tools.description: List Empiva's dining packages (breakfast, half-board, full-board, private chef). Optionally filter by destination. Returns each package's name, meal type and per-person-per-day price in EUR.

tools.name: empiva_list_experiences
tools.description: List Empiva's curated experiences (hammam rituals, desert stargazing, truffle hunting, and more). Optionally filter by destination. Returns each experience's name, slug, destination and per-person price in EUR.

tools.name: empiva_search_villas
tools.description: Search Empiva's luxury villas. Optionally filter by destination and minimum guest capacity. Returns each villa's name, slug, destination, capacity and indicative nightly rate in EUR. Use empiva_get_stay_quote for the exact price on specific dates.

guests.description: Minimum guests the villa must sleep
